description: LEAP-Asia-2018: Stress-strain response of Ottawa sand in Cyclic Torsional Shear Tests is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Kyohei Ueda, Kyoto University (kyoto-u.ac.jp). The results of cyclic torsional shear tests performed at Kyoto University (KyU) to characterize the stress-strain-strength response of Ottawa F-65 sand are archived in this project. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2D40H. Keywords: Cyclic Torsional Shear, Liquefaction resistance, Ottawa sand, Stress-strain response. Published 2018-12-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
